## 4. Interaction

- [ ] 4.1 Click-drag (or click) on an empty time range opens a create form pre-filled with that range; submitting persists via `POST /api/events` and renders the new event
- [ ] 4.2 Clicking an event opens an edit form supporting save (`PUT`) and delete (`DELETE`)
- [ ] 4.3 Previous / Today / Next week navigation refetches and re-renders
- [ ] 4.4 The week renders correctly on initial load from persisted data (reload reproduces the same layout)

## Acceptance Criteria (graded)

- Vertical geometry is exact: an event's top edge corresponds to its start time and its bottom edge to its end time, to the minute, against the hour grid.
- No two event blocks ever visually overlap, for any input data.
- N events sharing an identical time range render as N equal-width blocks side by side, together filling the day column's width.
- Partially overlapping chains (e.g. 09:00–11:00, 10:00–12:00, 11:30–13:00) render with every event fully visible and width divided only while contended.
- An event that overlaps nothing occupies the full width of its day column, even when other clusters exist earlier the same day.
- Events are rendered only within their own day column; an event ending at 24:00 terminates exactly at the column's bottom edge.
- Creating, editing, and deleting events updates the rendered week and persists across a full server restart and page reload.
- Invalid events (empty title, end not after start) are rejected with HTTP 400 and nothing is persisted.

## Complete Calendar Week View Implementation

### Project Structure
```
├── package.json              # Root package with backend deps + dev scripts
├── backend/
│   └── server.js             # Express + PGLite server
├── frontend/
│   ├── package.json          # Frontend package (Vite)
│   ├── vite.config.js        # Vite config with API proxy to :3001
│   ├── index.html            # SPA entry point with modal
│   └── src/
│       ├── style.css         # Full CSS with grid layout, event blocks, modal
│       ├── main.js           # App entry: rendering, interaction, CRUD
│       ├── api.js            # HTTP client for events API
│       ├── layout.js         # Cluster-based overlap layout engine
│       └── date-utils.js     # Date/time utilities for week navigation
```

### Key Components

**Backend (Express + PGLite):**
- PGLite embedded PostgreSQL writes to `./pgdata/` for durable persistence
- `events` table with `id`, `title`, `start_at`, `end_at` and `CHECK(end_at > start_at)`
- `GET /api/events?start=&end=` - range overlap query
- `POST /api/events` - create with validation (400 for invalid)
- `PUT /api/events/:id` - update with validation
- `DELETE /api/events/:id` - delete

**Layout Engine (`layout.js`):**
- Sorts events by start time, then descending end time
- Builds maximal overlap clusters by tracking cluster end time
- Greedy column assignment within each cluster (lowest free column)
- Each cluster independently determines its column count
- Non-overlapping events after a cluster get full width (separate cluster)

**Frontend Rendering:**
- CSS Grid layout: gutter (60px) + 7 equal day columns
- Sticky day headers with today highlight
- Time axis: 24 hours × 60px = 1440px total height
- Event positioning: `top = (minuteStart/1440) × 1440px`, `height = (duration/1440) × 1440px`
- Event width: `100% / totalColumns`, left: `column × width%`
- Events clamped to their day column; midnight (1440 minutes) = bottom edge
- Text overflow handled with ellipsis

**Interaction:**
- Click/drag on empty time range → create modal pre-filled with snapped times
- Click event block → edit modal with save and delete buttons
- Prev/Today/Next navigation with refetch
- Escape key and overlay click close modal

### Verified Behaviors
- All CRUD operations work and persist across server restarts
- Invalid input (empty title, end ≤ start) rejected with HTTP 400
- Layout algorithm correctly handles: single events (full width), N identical events (N equal columns), partial overlap chains (greedy column reuse), events after cluster ends (full width restored)
- Events ending at 24:00 terminate at exact bottom edge
